summary: Iteration 2 of RideBuddy (redesigned UI + days-based pricing). Backend: 16/16 pytest passed AFTER fixing one CRITICAL bug. Frontend: full happy-path E2E completed end-to-end (login -> OTP -> onboarding car make/model -> home with date picker -> fare estimate -> summary -> payment -> finding -> booking detail with driver auto-assigned; bookings list with tabs renders correctly).

critical.issue: FIXED by test agent: BookingIn Pydantic schema was missing `days: int = 0` and `return_at: Optional[str] = None`. As a result, ALL booking creation POSTs returned 500 InternalServerError with AttributeError: 'BookingIn' object has no attribute 'days'. The frontend payment.tsx sends both fields. Without this fix the entire booking flow (and therefore the entire app's primary user journey) was broken.

minor.issue: logger.info call at line 457 references `logger` but `logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)` is never defined in server.py. Currently silent because seeding only runs on cold start with empty drivers collection, but will throw NameError if hit. Add `logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)` near the top.
Pydantic v2 will warn that `EstimateIn.days` has a literal default; not blocking.

rca_of_issue: RCA: The BookingIn Pydantic schema was authored without the new fields that the redesigned frontend now sends. Backend code (compute_fare and Booking model construction) had been updated to consume `body.days`, but the input schema BookingIn (lines 137-150 of server.py) was not updated alongside. Pydantic v2 strict-by-default would normally reject extra fields, but FastAPI here silently dropped them; the crash came from `body.days` AttributeError during fare computation in create_booking. FIX: Added `days: int = 0` and `return_at: Optional[str] = None` to BookingIn. Verified by re-running pytest and the live frontend E2E: a 19-day round-trip booking (Mumbai->Pune) was created successfully with total=₹24,681 and was auto-assigned a driver. Reproduction steps: 1) login any phone, 2) go to home, 3) pick pickup+return dates spanning >1 day, 4) tap Fare Estimate -> Confirm & Pay -> Pay Now. Without the fix, step 4 returns 500. With the fix, it succeeds and navigates to /booking/finding then /booking/[id].
